decisions.reason: A navigation and observation camera close to the core space offer, with its own page, has uncertain but promising prospects and costs little to keep while space-qualification and mission adoption play out over long cycles.
A modular camera line fits the firm's strategic push toward flexible sensors for small satellites, so keeping it preserves a valuable growth option at low marginal cost in a growing market.

Space situational awareness is an emerging and uncertain but expanding field, so the option value of staying in it is high and the evidence after one year is far too early to show the value cannot be realized.

The miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned and less visibly promoted, but it is close to the firm's docking and navigation competence and still early in long space sales cycles, so the uncertainty has not resolved enough to justify dropping it.
